payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort the array of square sizes, then pick the (n-k)-th smallest element to output as (x,y) point, ensuring it lies in exactly k squares.
payload.rationale: The solution uses sorting to enable a greedy threshold selection: after sorting ascending, the point (a[n-k], a[n-k]) lies on the diagonal and is inside the k largest squares, satisfying exactly k inclusions. This matches the greedy_sorting_order pattern.
